task_description: Combined single-PR fix for ARV Coin. PART B (FEAT-002): retarget ARV to ~Rs.10,000 today (arv_base_inr ~= 17.83) while still tracking real Bitcoin's ~560x 10-year shape; kill the end-of-chart spike and the wrong since-launch % by force-rebuilding ALL arv_candles to a single current anchor. Root cause: on live installs the v8 migration re-queued backfill but auto_backfill_step() skips timeframes whose row count already exceeds the floor, so pre-rescale (old-anchor) candles were never recomputed while fresh ingest wrote new-anchor minutes -> a right-edge discontinuity. Fix = new anchor everywhere + schema 8->9 corrective migration that force-sets anchor settings and re-queues an UNCONDITIONAL candle rebuild (candles only; NO re-run of the v8 unit rescale, no wallet/lot/ledger writes) + backfill overwrites old rows regardless of count + consistent sinceLaunchPct/stats math. PART A (FEAT-003): show ARV value in USD ($) alongside Rs. everywhere the LIVE/current price/NAV is shown, using snapshot.index.fxUsdInr (fallback CFG.FEED.fx.fallbackRate 94.95); historical/point-in-time rows stay Rs.-only; USD is display-only, money path untouched. PART C (FEAT-004): CoinDCX-style mobile bottom tab bar replacing the hamburger as the primary mobile navigation, plus a Help/Support section that emails info@ARVcoin.com. USER DECISIONS captured via steering + user_input: (1) target ~Rs.10,000 today with BTC-matched ~560x history (supersedes the earlier Rs.1000); (2) proper continuous minute-by-minute recent history, no artificial spike. Money invariants preserved throughout (integer paise, units*1e8, append-only ledger, index-price fills, issuance cannot move price, stale feed pauses trading). NO MySQL/exchange/WebSocket in sandbox: migration/backfill/ingest are UNVERIFIABLE here and must be validated on the live install.

verification.summary: No build step and no automated test suite in this project. php -l passes on all api/*.php and root install.php (no syntax errors). env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check passes on all js/*.js, js/pages/*.js and arv-config.js. No Docker (Hostinger shared hosting). Highest-risk change (schema 8->9 corrective migration) reviewed by reading: guarded by anchor_recomputed_v9 (idempotent, one-shot), force-sets only the four anchor settings + backfill scheduling + rebuild flag, and provably touches NO wallets/lots/ledger rows (grep confirmed only comments mention them). auto_backfill_step() rebuild-flag logic verified: while arv_candles_rebuild_v9 is set, ARV timeframes bypass the row-count skip and are recomputed via index_price(); the flag clears on both the skip and success paths once the chain advances into the asset steps or 'done'. USD display is frontend-only (fmtUsd/fmtDual in js/ui.js, reads snapshot.index.fxUsdInr with CFG.FEED.fx.fallbackRate 94.95 fallback); historical rows (tax/transactions/avgCostNav) kept rupee-only; money path untouched. Bottom tab bar + Help are additive UI. DEFERRED (UNVERIFIABLE in sandbox - no MySQL/exchange/WebSocket): running the schema-9 migration, the full candle rebuild/backfill, confirming NAV lands ~Rs.10,000 with a sane since-launch % and a single continuous series with no end spike, and confirming wallet units/lots/ledger are unchanged. All recorded per-feature in findings for live validation.
